lines.text: Paul tells the spiritual to restore someone caught in a trespass gently, watching themselves so they are not tempted.
Paul says that carrying one another's burdens fulfills the law of Moses.
Paul says anyone who thinks he is something when he is nothing deceives himself, and each should carry his own load.
Paul says whatever a man sows he will reap, and the one sowing to please the Spirit will reap great riches.
Paul says not to grow weary in well-doing, and to do good to everyone, especially the family of faith.
